title: Principal Product Manager, Enterprise AI
hiring_location: Bellevue, Washington, Chicago, Illinois, San Francisco, California
jd_excerpt:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 The Enterprise AI Engineering Team 
At Okta, you’ll be part of an Enterprise AI Engineering Team that spans the US and India. You’ll work on cutting-edge Applied AI products while shaping the platform foundations that make secure, scalable AI possible at enterprise scale. If you’re passionate about building AI that is smarter, faster, and always secure , this is your opportunity to make an impact.
 The Principal Product Manager, Enterprise AI Opportunity 
Okta is building the next generation of AI-native enterprise products, transforming how customers, employees, and partners work. Within Technology, Data & Intelligence (TDI), we operate as Customer Zero, designing and delivering AI-powered products that reshape how Okta Secures AI and inform what we bring to market.
You’ll own the full lifecycle of AI-native enterprise products, from 0->1 innovations to 1->N scaling them into company-wide capabilities. You'll balance rapid experimentation with disciplined execution, building AI experiences that fundamentally change how work gets done.
 What you’ll be doing 
 Discover and validate new AI use cases (0→1 innovation)
 Build and ship AI-native experiences: agents, copilots, workflow automation
 Scale proven products into reliable, reusable capabilities (1→N)
 Define quality metrics, evaluate AI performance, and drive adoption
 Partner across IT, HR, Finance, and GTM to ensure real business impact
 What you'll bring to the role 
 Experience: 
 10+ years in product management, with 2+ years shipping AI/ML products in production
 Track record taking products from idea → MVP → broad adoption
 Experience building AI-powered products with LLMs, agents, or RAG
 Skills: 
 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and how to apply them to real problems
 Ability to balance speed and quality, knowing when to experiment vs. standardize
 Experience building AI evaluation frameworks and measuring quality
 Excellent cross-functional leadership and storytelling skills
 User empathy and ability to translate complex workflows into simple experiences
 Nice-to-have: 
 Familiarity with responsible AI principles and enterprise compliance
 Understanding of AI operational economics (costs, latency, quality tradeoffs)
 Experience with agentic system design
 Why Join Us 
 Customer Zero Impact: Build products that reshape how Okta Secures AI, informing what we bring to market
 Speed + Scale: Combine startup-like innovation with enterprise rigor
 AI Leadership: Work at the intersection of identity and AI, two of the most important domains in enterprise software
